correctness.rationale: Let Z_i be the clean-window indicators. Then W_b=n-sum_i Z_i, E Z_i=r^b, and for offset d the joint clean event is exactly avoidance on the union of two cyclic length-b windows. Direct set counting gives union size u_0=b and u_d=2b-max(0,b-d)-max(0,b-(n-d)); therefore E[Z_i Z_{i+d}]=r^{u_d} and the stated covariance sum follows by cyclic translation invariance. The n>=2b reduction leaves paired overlap offsets d=1,...,b-1 with union size b+d and zero covariance for disjoint offsets. Boundary cases p=0, p=1, b=1 and b=n are consistent. An independent exact rational replay over all binary support patterns for small n reproduced both moments; it was used only as a check on the analytic proof.
